cells.content:
## Read this first

- **Zero automation runs finished in the last 24 hours.** `automation_report summary` and `list_runs` both returned 0 for the window since Nov 18. The most recent finished run was **Nov 16, 06:11 UTC** (run `9d2e3651308bda4d`, 1/1 passed). Everything below the 24h KPIs is therefore **7-day / library context**, not today's execution.
- **0 API calls** logged in the last 24h (`api_report summary`, 21-call log) — no API signal today.
- Test management agrees: `get_health_score` reports **execution freshness 0 — "0 executed in last 7 days"**, which is what drags the health score to 58.

## What the numbers say

- **Pass rate 61.3% (7d)** = 19 passed ÷ 31 executed across 11 runs. The average of each run's own rate is only **25.5%** — many runs are single-test runs that failed outright (Nov 14 was the heavy day).
- **8 distinct tests failed 12 times** in 7d; the two *Manager buys the cheapest electronics with a coupon* data rows (`Maya Patel`, `Leo Grant`) share the same root cause: `filter-category` never resolves in `ShopPage.applyProductFilters`.
- **4 tests at 50% flakiness** — all four are green in the Sanity Test suite but red as standalone runs, so the suite path and the direct path disagree.
- **Library is mostly unexercised:** 33 of 57 scripts have never run, 11 are failing at their last run, 13 passing. `tests/forms` (6) and `tests/dynamic` (5) have never run at all.
- **Coverage is requirement-complete but automation-thin:** 20/20 requirements covered (100%) yet only 55/122 cases automated (45%), with 50 stale cases and 55 orphan test cases.
